notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Famished Paladin lifelink.
description:
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain one life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.
